name: Bavvai
overview: Bavvai is a male biblical figure noted for his role in carrying out repairs, as recorded in Nehemiah 3:18. The Scripture highlights his contribution to the restoration efforts but does not specify his tribal affiliation or additional personal details.
namesAndTitles: The name Bavvai appears only once in the biblical text, and no specific meaning or divine origin is provided for this proper name. It is presented plainly without further explanation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Bavvai as the son of Henadad. Beyond this filial relationship, no other family connections are recorded in the biblical account.
scriptureSignificance: Bavvai's significance lies in his participation in the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls, demonstrating faithful service in the physical and spiritual restoration of the city. His work symbolizes the collective effort of God's people to reestablish their community under divine guidance. Although details about him are limited, his mention underscores the importance of every contributor in fulfilling God's purposes during this pivotal time.
